name: UsbDk
purpose: Takes a USB device away from its own Windows driver on the client PC while the VM uses it (usb-v1, docs/usb-redirection.md)

signature.how: Get-AuthenticodeSignature on a downloaded copy; the MSI was not run
signature.issuer: Symantec Class 3 SHA256 Code Signing CA - G2
signature.status: Valid (the certificate expired 2022-01-26; the Symantec timestamp keeps the signature valid)

notes: The MSI is not stored in this repository. tools/fetch-usb-drivers.ps1 -UsbDk downloads it into .tools/usb-drivers/usbdk-1.0.22 and checks the SHA-256; the client build (windows/CMakeLists.txt) copies it to usbdk/ beside the client when present.
The client never runs it on its own: the USB panel asks, then verifies size, SHA-256 and the Red Hat, Inc. signature and runs msiexec /i /qn /norestart (usb_capture.cpp InstallUsbDk).
UsbDk 1.0.22 is the last release (2020). Memory Integrity (HVCI) compatibility was not verified; it is a filter driver on every USB hub of the PC while installed.
